items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: a wonderful trombone player who became a comedian, like me, Jerry Colanna was the trombone player with that band.

ctx.x: I wonder if anybody ever thought of trying to get them to record together.

Impossible. They worked in the same band together on radio, I don’t know if you know this, Monk. I have a picture also of a band called Al Goodman and his Orchestra. It’s not related to Benny Goodman. Al Goodman and his Radio Orchestra. And he had in that band playing saxophone and clarinet Benny Goodman and Artie Shaw. This was like a 25, 30 piece orchestra with strings and all. They played radio shows. Al Goodman and his Orchestra. Then I have a picture of Benny Goodman just playing clarinet with Lenny Hayton’s…
Radio was really important for musicians at that time, wasn’t it?
